use.zh-cn: 核心对象与配置；区分任务、continuous期望态及execution。停止态bounded创建、预检和显式运行边界不变。
use.en: Core objects/configuration distinguish task, continuous desired state and execution. Stopped bounded creation, preflight and explicit execution remain unchanged.

use.zh-cn: 本次新增独立的委托启动分支：首次仅申请 Owner 审批，批准后按原引用消费；不改变创建为执行。
use.en: This change adds a separate delegated start branch: request owner approval first, then consume its approved reference; creation still does not execute.

use.zh-cn: 复核只读草稿构建接入后的同文件变化。原创建、运行审批及执行读取边界保留，完整参数仍走正式预检和确认。 复核 FileGDB 单表导出的专属来源及授权约束。此改动属于 Manager 发起的导出，不扩大 Agent 的原生表任务创建范围。
use.en: Reviewed this file after read-only draft construction integration. Creation, owner run approval and execution read boundaries remain, with complete arguments still checked and reviewed. Reviewed FileGDB single-table export source and authorization constraints. This applies to Manager-initiated export and does not expand the Agent native-table task creation scope.

use.zh-cn: 正式委托路由覆盖创建停止态与拒绝错误范围、执行、计划、扫描；新增角色选择请求必须 409，且零本人角色请求、不增加定义或执行。
use.en: The formal delegated route covers stopped creation and rejects wrong scopes, execution, schedules and scanning; a role-choice request must return 409 with no current-user role lookup or additional definition/execution.

use.zh-cn: 复核默认类型由 Transfer 推导及新草稿多源必须确认的改动。模型不复制源类型为覆盖参数；Runtime 基于正式搜索候选暂停并核对恢复选择。完整原参数绑定、预检三态、创建和运行审批边界保持。
use.en: Reviewed owner-derived default types and mandatory multi-source selection for new drafts. Source types are not copied as overrides; Runtime pauses on formal candidates and checks the resumed choice. Exact parameter binding, tri-state preflight, creation and run approval boundaries remain.

use.zh-cn: 共享ResourceFact局部$defs展开后逐项比较验证规则，结构化引用的必填、封闭结构和名称约束不被忽略；创建标准类型、快照replace/append与upsert/keys/计划/凭据拒绝断言保持。
use.en: Resolve local ResourceFact $defs before comparing every validation rule, retaining structured-reference requirements, closed objects and name constraints. Existing standard-type, snapshot replace/append and rejection tests for upsert, keys, schedules and credentials remain.

use.zh-cn: 新草稿的集合搜索和草稿构建均绑定正式选定的源引擎。选择失效时重新确认引擎及源集合。限定搜索正式返回零命中时，Runtime 显示已查引擎和搜索词并等待补充，恢复后在重新核验的引擎内搜索。
use.en: For new drafts, bind collection search and draft construction to the selected source engine. Reconfirm the engine and collection if the selection becomes invalid. On a formal scoped zero-hit result, Runtime displays the engine and search term, waits for more information, and revalidates the engine before searching on resume.

use.zh-cn: confirmed_source要求正式结构化事实，MQL aggregate必须与Owner的单分段引用精确匹配，无旧字段兜底；条件列表、预检及复核算法未改，但事实内容进入完整指纹，刷新后的引用或能力修订变化必须重新确认。
use.en: confirmed_source requires formal structured facts; MQL aggregate must exactly match the owner single-part reference, without a legacy fallback. Conditions, precheck and review algorithms are unchanged, but the full fingerprint binds facts, so refreshed references or a new capability revision require renewed confirmation.

use.zh-cn: 夹具明确创建能力身份，原条件和拒绝断言不变。
use.en: Fixtures explicitly select creation capability; existing condition and refusal assertions are unchanged.

use.zh-cn: 支持矩阵及快照replace/append保持；CDC加列审批后idle/paused，显式Resume才新建execution。不扩张本包continuous能力。
use.en: Keep the matrix and snapshot replace/append. CDC approval leaves idle/paused; explicit Resume creates an execution. No continuous capability expansion.

use.zh-cn: 所选源引擎约束新草稿的集合搜索及构建，原选择失效时撤销旧集合候选和确认。限定搜索成功且总数为零时，Runtime 根据正式引擎名称和实际搜索词生成纯文字澄清，暂停同一 Run 并阻断未执行的同批调用。用户补充后恢复该 Run，重读引擎清单并核验限定。
use.en: The selected source engine constrains collection search and construction for new drafts. When the selection becomes invalid, revoke the old collection choices and confirmations. When a scoped search succeeds with a total of zero, Runtime uses the formal engine name and actual search term to ask for a text reply, pauses the same Run, and blocks the remaining calls in the batch. The reply resumes that Run and refreshes and revalidates the engine scope.

use.zh-cn: 复核 Runtime 参数来源绑定后的同文件变化。完整候选只来自正式构建、历史引用或用户原配置，已有预检、确认及运行审批边界保持。
use.en: Reviewed this file after Runtime parameter source binding. Exact candidates come from formal construction, historical references or original user input, retaining preflight, review and run approval boundaries.

use.zh-cn: 预检、源候选澄清和历史界面的双语提示。
use.en: Bilingual preflight, source clarification and history feedback.

use.zh-cn: 复核 Manager 一次性 FileGDB 导出，仅给未建模的 encoded 归档执行增加精确 Infra 对象目标。停止态 native table 的 bounded/snapshot、replace/append、查询与字段资格校验，以及创建权限、条件和效果保持；不执行、调度或扫描。 复核 FileGDB 单表导出的专属来源及授权约束。此改动属于 Manager 发起的导出，不扩大 Agent 的原生表任务创建范围。
use.en: Reviewed Manager one-off FileGDB export, which adds an exact Infra object target for unmodeled encoded archive execution. Stopped native creation retains bounded/snapshot, replace/append, query and field checks, permissions, conditions and effects; no execution, schedule or scan. Reviewed FileGDB single-table export source and authorization constraints. This applies to Manager-initiated export and does not expand the Agent native-table task creation scope.

use.zh-cn: 复核 Runtime 参数来源绑定后的同文件变化。完整候选只来自正式构建、历史引用或用户原配置，已有预检、确认及运行审批边界保持。
use.en: Reviewed this file after Runtime parameter source binding. Exact candidates come from formal construction, historical references or original user input, retaining preflight, review and run approval boundaries.

use.zh-cn: 平台路由从当前请求提取源名称和类型线索，并核对线索出现在本轮正文。
use.en: Platform routing extracts source name and type clues and checks that the clues occur in the current request.

use.zh-cn: 绑定正式构建、历史或用户配置；历史定位不回放创建、运行。
use.en: Bind construction, history or user configuration; navigation never replays creation or execution.

use.zh-cn: 复核 Runtime 参数来源绑定后的同文件变化。完整候选只来自正式构建、历史引用或用户原配置，已有预检、确认及运行审批边界保持。
use.en: Reviewed this file after Runtime parameter source binding. Exact candidates come from formal construction, historical references or original user input, retaining preflight, review and run approval boundaries.

use.zh-cn: 受控持久层核对草稿引用、原参数、文字顺序和完整 content；同消息逐批更新，计划按稳定身份替换，安全事件保留各次更新。正式卡片与固定提示断言保持；非真实数据库或部署验收。
use.en: Controlled persistence checks exact draft references, arguments, text order and full content. One message updates incrementally; plans replace under stable identity while safe events retain updates. Formal cards and fixed-message assertions stay intact; not live database or deployment acceptance.

use.zh-cn: 只合并相邻文字，不跨 Presentation 重排；持久化仍使用原字节上限和深复制，不过滤内容
use.en: Merge only adjacent text without reordering across presentations; persistence retains byte bounds and deep copying without filtering content

use.zh-cn: 验证相邻文字、卡片后文字和刷新终态，不改历史原件。
use.en: Test adjacent text, text after cards and persisted state without rewriting history.

use.zh-cn: 从同一已预检参数显示受限事实概要，复用共享定位符、表格和 JSON；长名称完整换行，不新增事实、任务状态、action 或请求。
use.en: Display bounded facts from the same checked arguments using shared locators, tables and JSON. Wrap complete long names without adding facts, task state, actions or requests.

use.zh-cn: 本次纳入已提交的 fake timer 清理，等待表格延迟布局后拆卸 DOM；原完整快照、映射和只读断言未删改。
use.en: Includes committed fake-timer cleanup that flushes table layout before DOM teardown; full-snapshot, mapping and readonly assertions are retained.

use.zh-cn: 用户复核并手动决定；失败仅安全提示，不恢复、重试、启动或历史回放。
use.en: User reviews and decides; failures show safe feedback without resume, retry, start or replay.

use.zh-cn: 路由结果携带本轮源引擎限定，供正式引擎清单匹配。
use.en: Route output carries the current source engine scope for matching against the formal inventory.

use.zh-cn: 检查点保存本轮源范围和正式源引擎选择，包括唯一匹配的引擎。检查点只接受正式候选中的源引擎选择，为恢复核验提供依据。
use.en: The checkpoint stores the current scope and formal source-engine selection, including a unique match. It accepts only selections from formal engine choices for validation on resume.

use.en: Test drafts, decisions and bilingual failures; invalid codes or 401 never replay or expose owner text.

use.zh-cn: 角色方式保存只消费当前第一方 User 的角色事实；无选择直接返回。角色手动执行需独立 EA，不赋予委托创建运行权。
use.en: Role-choice saves consume only current first-party User role facts; absent choices return directly. Manual role execution requires separate EA and does not grant delegated creation execution rights.

use.zh-cn: 本人角色读取要求未到期第一方 Tenant User，拒绝 Delegated／Service，不替换服务令牌、不保存凭据；不授予数据或执行权限。
use.en: Current role reads require a live first-party Tenant User and reject Delegated/Service identities without substituting service tokens or retaining credentials; no data or execution permission is granted.

use.en: Controlled batch fixtures explicitly select creation capability; original no-retry, no-enumeration and no-write assertions after search failure remain.

use.en: Reviewed this file after read-only draft construction integration. Creation, owner run approval and execution read boundaries remain, with complete arguments still checked and reviewed.

use.zh-cn: 只用已保存完整／采样结构检查目标 Provider；保留确定反证，采样正向赋值降为 unknown，无有效快照不补造源类型；不读取业务行。
use.en: Checks target Provider rules from persisted complete or sampled schemas, retaining contradictions but keeping sampled assignments unknown; no invented unobserved types or business-row reads.

use.zh-cn: 映射后保留源字段及元素类型的已观察事实，不继承采样目标约束；未观察字段仍未知，跟随既有字段映射主链路。
use.en: Preserves observed source and element types through mapping without inheriting sampled target constraints; unobserved fields stay unknown on the existing mapping path.

use.zh-cn: 纯 Mongo 投影别名到 PostgreSQL 定义检查：对象／数字数组拒绝；字符串、未知元素、JSON、复杂查询及未观察快照保留 unknown，诊断绑定映射位置且不改事实。
use.en: Pure Mongo projection aliases reach PostgreSQL definition checking: object/numeric arrays reject; strings, unknown elements, JSON, complex queries and unobserved snapshots stay unknown; locations remain bound and facts unchanged.

use.zh-cn: 验证采样源反证保留、不成为目标类型／精度约束，未观察字段不变成确定 NULL，原始字段映射来源保持。
use.en: Verifies sampled counterexamples survive without becoming target type/precision constraints; unobserved fields never become known NULL and mapping provenance is preserved.

use.zh-cn: 从已确认选择只读编译配置，核验正式结构、四项权限和独立预检组合。草稿不保存任务、不授权运行。
use.en: Read-only compilation of confirmed choices with formal facts, four permissions and independent preflight composition. Draft construction neither persists a task nor approves a run.

use.zh-cn: 按正式祖先链核验完整分段身份，拒绝含点名称的 full_name 碰撞；构建与预检仍只读，三种参数来源保留。
use.en: Verify complete owner ancestor identity segments and reject flattened full_name collisions for dotted names, retaining read-only compilation/preflight and the three parameter sources.

use.zh-cn: 从已确认选择只读编译配置，核验正式结构、四项权限和独立预检组合。草稿不保存任务、不授权运行。
use.en: Read-only compilation of confirmed choices with formal facts, four permissions and independent preflight composition. Draft construction neither persists a task nor approves a run.

use.en: Reviewed owner-derived default types and mandatory multi-source selection for new drafts. Source types are not copied as overrides; Runtime pauses on formal candidates and checks the resumed choice. Exact parameter binding, tri-state preflight, creation and run approval boundaries remain.

use.zh-cn: 从已确认选择只读编译配置，核验正式结构、四项权限和独立预检组合。草稿不保存任务、不授权运行。
use.en: Read-only compilation of confirmed choices with formal facts, four permissions and independent preflight composition. Draft construction neither persists a task nor approves a run.

use.en: Read-only compilation of confirmed choices with formal facts, four permissions and independent preflight composition. Draft construction neither persists a task nor approves a run.

use.zh-cn: 从已确认选择只读编译配置，核验正式结构、四项权限和独立预检组合。草稿不保存任务、不授权运行。
use.en: Read-only compilation of confirmed choices with formal facts, four permissions and independent preflight composition. Draft construction neither persists a task nor approves a run.

use.zh-cn: 核验三种原参数来源、同身份恢复、拒绝改写及短输入构建预检链。受控测试不代替真实业务环境。
use.en: Verifies three exact parameter sources, identity-bound recovery, mutation rejection and short-request construction/preflight. Controlled tests do not replace real business acceptance.

use.zh-cn: 受控测试确认失效后撤销旧集合及确认，旧 locator 在构建前被拒绝。限定搜索零命中后，用户补充集合名可恢复同一 Run，Runtime 重读引擎清单并仍按已选引擎搜索。
use.en: Controlled tests verify that invalidation revokes old collections and confirmations and that an old locator is rejected before construction. After scoped zero hits, a collection name supplied by the user resumes the same Run, refreshes the engine inventory, and searches within the selected engine.

sources.anchor: Transfer 参数来源只接受三种受信任输入

use.zh-cn: 源引擎约束搜索与构建；零命中恢复同Run，历史只读不授权写入。
use.en: Source engine bounds search and construction; zero-hit clarification resumes the Run. History grants no writes.

use.zh-cn: 简短新草稿场景要求先读取引擎目录，再限定源搜索，最后对 Owner 构建结果进行同参预检。
use.en: The short draft scenario requires engine inventory before scoped source search and exact preflight of the owner-built arguments.

use.zh-cn: 受控评测核对多引擎在搜索前暂停。限定搜索零命中后，Runtime 发出文字澄清，并拦截同批重搜、目标目录、草稿构建和预检。
use.en: Controlled evaluation checks pause before search on multiple engines. After a scoped zero-hit search, Runtime asks for a text reply and blocks repeated search, target discovery, draft construction, and preflight from the same batch.

use.zh-cn: 核验多引擎选项的正式身份。零命中场景要求仅执行一次搜索，并返回写明引擎、搜索词及未找到结果的无选项澄清。
use.en: Check formal identity for multiple engine options. The zero-hit scenario requires exactly one search and a clarification with no choices that identifies the engine, search term, and absence of results.

use.zh-cn: 夹具提供多个同类型源引擎、目标引擎及限定搜索零命中，供两项受控评测复现。
use.en: Fixtures provide multiple source engines of the same type, a target engine, and scoped zero hits for the two controlled evaluations.

use.zh-cn: 显式源引擎场景要求读取引擎目录后按范围搜索，多集合候选须暂停选择。
use.en: For an explicit source engine, read the inventory before scoped search and suspend on multiple collection candidates.

use.zh-cn: 超过生产历史窗口后，以合成摘要辅助指代并读取精确历史草稿，不从摘要重建参数或授予权限。
use.en: Beyond the production history window, a synthetic summary assists reference resolution to an exact historical draft, without reconstructing parameters or granting permission.

use.zh-cn: 旧传输摘要不覆盖当前只读查询目标；不能继承旧任务领域、确认或运行意图。
use.en: An old transfer summary cannot override the current read-only query goal or carry forward an old task domain, confirmation or run intent.

use.zh-cn: 未限定源引擎时允许跨引擎搜索。多个正式候选须暂停选择，覆盖到澄清为止。
use.en: An unspecified source engine permits cross-engine search. Multiple formal candidates must suspend for selection; this scenario ends at clarification.

use.zh-cn: 验证拒绝拼接 locator、重复候选、表叶节点和非正式值，且确认时仅保存所选 schema 的正式事实。
use.en: Verify rejection of composite locators, duplicate choices, table leaves, and unobserved values, and persist only the chosen schema's formal fact on confirmation.

use.zh-cn: 多源引擎候选暂停在集合搜索之前，保留正式候选及无写操作的断言。
use.en: Multiple source engines suspend before collection search with formal choices and assertions of zero writes.

use.zh-cn: 正式限定搜索零命中后暂停等待文字澄清，期间不调用目录、结构、草稿构建或预检工具。
use.en: A formal scoped zero-hit search pauses for a text reply before any directory, resource facts, draft construction, or preflight calls.

use.zh-cn: 按会话、用户、租户重建历史回复与终态，不回放写操作。
use.en: Project replies and state within session/user/tenant; never replay writes.

use.zh-cn: 待答独立于窗口；锚点重读保持已完成终态。
use.en: Pending facts span all history; anchored reload preserves completion.

summary.zh-cn: 只建未启动的 native table 有界快照任务，目标仅 replace/append；复核和创建前正式只读预检，unsupported 阻止创建，unknown 明示限制后知情确认；不保证实际值转换或执行成功，不是 Transfer 全功能声明
summary.en: Create only a stopped native table bounded snapshot task with replace/append; formal read-only checks precede review and creation, unsupported blocks creation and unknown requires informed confirmation; no guarantee of value conversion, execution success or full Transfer coverage

summary.zh-cn: Continuous/Kafka 与数据库 CDC尚未纳入本能力定义
summary.en: Continuous Kafka and database CDC is not modeled in this capability

summary.zh-cn: Watermark 增量装载尚未纳入本能力定义
summary.en: Watermark incremental load is not modeled in this capability

summary.zh-cn: 该创建能力不包含执行；运行审批与结果查询由独立 transfer.task.start 和 transfer.execution.get 能力声明，不继承创建确认。
summary.en: This creation capability excludes execution; independent transfer.task.start and transfer.execution.get describe owner-approved running and observation, without inheriting creation review.

summary.zh-cn: 文件、对象与 raw copy 传输尚未纳入本能力定义
summary.en: File, object and raw copy transfer is not modeled in this capability

summary.zh-cn: 当前第一方 User 的角色专用字段方式、手动 EA 执行及导出交付尚未纳入本委托创建能力；不借用发布人、服务或委托人角色。
summary.en: Current first-party User role-specific field choices, manual EA execution and export delivery are not modeled by this delegated creation capability; publisher, service or delegator roles are not borrowed.
